brand.name: SoleFresh
brand.support: A reusable shoe-care product designed to manage odor and moisture and keep footwear fresher between wears.

segments.label: Who it's for
segments.orgNote: In development. Facility pilots are how we test it.

items.name: Bowling centers
items.line: Rental shoes worn by many customers a day. One insert goes in each shoe while the pair is on the shelf.

items.name: Skating rinks
items.line: Rental skates sit deep. The pull cord is there to lift the insert out of a laced skate.

items.name: Schools and athletic departments
items.line: Equipment rooms and team footwear. One insert per shoe, instead of separate products for moisture, odor and scent.

items.name: Sports teams and clubs
items.line: Training and competition footwear. Three housing sizes; which fits cleats and court shoes is part of what a pilot checks.

items.name: Athletes and everyday wearers
items.line: Gym-goers, runners, students. One insert in each shoe between wears.

what.heading: What it does.
what.lede: Three jobs in one reusable insert.

hotspots.label: Odor
hotspots.text: An activated-carbon pouch, for the odor that builds up with wear.

hotspots.label: Moisture
hotspots.text: A silica-gel pouch, for dampness from sweat.

hotspots.label: Scent
hotspots.text: Scent beads in a bay at the heel end.

note.text: How well each part works is what our pilot tests.

steps.title: Shoes come off
steps.caption: After a game, a session, practice or a shift.

steps.title: Place SoleFresh inside
steps.caption: Drop one in each shoe, narrow end first.

steps.title: Leave it in between wears
steps.caption: It stays inside while the shoes sit.

steps.title: Pull it out and reuse it
steps.caption: Pull it out by the cord before the next wear. Put it back after.

inside.heading: Three jobs. One refillable insert.
inside.lede: One SoleFresh goes in each shoe between wears. Load it to see what's inside.
inside.note: Prototype. Drying, odor and scent performance haven't been measured yet.
inside.compare: Compare with what you use now
inside.optionalOut: Without it, the housing holds the other two. Same housing, same sizes.

rest.title: Moisture, odor, scent.
rest.body: Covering all three can mean separate products to buy, place and replace. SoleFresh is designed to hold all three in one housing.

loaded.title: One insert. Place it, pull it, refill it.
loaded.body: Drop it in narrow end first when the shoes come off. Pull it out by the cord before the next wear. The 3D-printed housing is kept; the fills inside are replaced.

refilled.title: Same housing, fresh fill.
refilled.body: One fill comes out and a new one goes in. The housing stays in use.
refilled.foot: How often each fill needs replacing hasn't been measured yet. Our pilot measures it.

components.title: Moisture: silica-gel pouch
components.body: Silica-gel beads in a sealed, breathable pouch, on top of the stack.
components.foot: How it's recharged or replaced is being tested.

components.title: Odor: activated-carbon pouch
components.body: Activated carbon in a sealed pouch, on the insole side, under the silica.
components.foot: Designed as a replaceable refill pouch.

components.title: Scent: aroma beads
components.body: Scented beads in their own bay at the heel end. Small holes let the scent out and keep the beads in. Refill by pouring in new beads.
components.foot: Scent options are still to be announced.

components.title: Pull cord
components.body: Lifts the insert out of footwear where it sits deep, like laced skates.

customize.heading: Sizes and colors.
customize.lede: Three housing sizes and four prototype colors.

dragHint.fine: Drag the product to turn it.
dragHint.touch: Drag the product sideways to turn it.
dragHint.keys: Product preview. Turn it with the left and right arrow keys.

customize.note: Prototype colors and sizes. Final options may change.
customize.fit: One per shoe, two per pair. Which size fits which footwear is being checked with real shoes.

solefresh.label: SoleFresh
solefresh.what: A 3D-printed insert holding a moisture pouch, an odor pouch and scent beads. One per shoe.
solefresh.between: Dropped in, pulled out by its cord.
solefresh.usedUp: Only the fills. The housing is kept.

alternatives.label: Sprays
alternatives.what: A liquid sprayed into the shoe.
alternatives.takeaway: Scent comes from a refillable bead bay. Nothing is sprayed.

alternatives.label: Baking soda
alternatives.takeaway: The fills are sealed in pouches. Nothing loose goes in the shoe.

alternatives.label: Charcoal bags
alternatives.takeaway: Carbon too, plus a moisture pouch and scent, in one housing.

alternatives.label: Cedar inserts
alternatives.takeaway: One housing in three sizes. Only its fills are replaced.

alternatives.label: Disposables
alternatives.takeaway: The housing is kept. Only the fills are replaced.

alternatives.label: UV or heated dryers
alternatives.takeaway: No power needed. The cord is for pulling it out.

why.fine: SoleFresh is a prototype. Its performance, cost per use and staff time aren't measured yet: the facility pilot measures them.

story.heading: Our story.
story.line: SoleFresh is a student-founded startup, developed through INCubatoredu, a high school entrepreneurship program.

milestones.title: Concept
milestones.text: One reusable insert that handles moisture, odor and scent together.

milestones.title: Customer research
milestones.text: An informal survey of 50 high school athletes: 35 said shoe odor had bothered them at least once in the previous two weeks, and 36 were moderately to extremely interested in a product like this. Interest is not a purchase; pilots are how we find out.

milestones.title: First prototype
milestones.text: Built an early physical prototype to test the idea.

milestones.title: What we learned
milestones.text: The first prototype showed us what to work on: how quickly it handles moisture, how the scent sits alongside the other parts, and how it is built.

milestones.title: Refining now
milestones.text: Improving materials, effectiveness, cost and durability. Facility pilots are the next test.

faq.a: A reusable insert you place in a shoe between wears. One 3D-printed housing is designed to hold a moisture pouch, an odor pouch and scent beads.
Drop one in each shoe, narrow end first, when the shoes aren't being worn. Pull it out by its cord before they're worn again.
Yes. The 3D-printed housing is kept, and the fills inside are replaced. How often each fill needs replacing hasn't been measured yet.

faq.q: What does a facility pilot involve?
faq.a: Trying prototype inserts in some of your footwear and telling us what works. The details (how many, for how long) are worked out with each facility. Nothing is being sold.
We don't have performance results yet. Drying, odor and scent tests, and facility pilots, come first.
Yes, from scent beads in the housing. Specific scents haven't been announced.
Pricing hasn't been set, and there's nothing to buy yet.
It's in development. No launch date has been announced.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: SoleFresh is a student-founded startup developed through INCubatoredu, a high school entrepreneurship program. This page covers what you send us through the forms on this site.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.text: The facility pilot form asks for your organization's name and type, your name and email, and optionally the approximate pairs of shoes you manage, a phone number and a message. The waitlist form asks for your email.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.text: We'll only use this to contact you about SoleFresh.

sections.heading: Where it goes
sections.text: When you submit a form, this site's server passes your details to Google Sheets, a Google service. They are saved as a row in a private spreadsheet in a Google account we control, on Google's servers. We keep them for as long as we need them to contact you about SoleFresh, and delete them when you ask. See {googlePrivacy}.

sections.heading: This site
sections.text: This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics. It remembers the audience you picked in your browser for the current visit, so the pilot form can fill in your organization type, and the level of 3D detail your device handles. Its fonts are served from this site. To stop repeat submissions, the server briefly holds your IP address in memory. The site is hosted on Vercel.
